draft_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise: its F1 drop stayed within the pre-specified criterion at 10%, 20% and 30% noise (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points).
rationale: The package only reports exp1 (original labels, 5 seeds, Table T1). No label-noise conditions, no perturbation F1 drops, and no Table T2 exist. The cited evidence IDs (T2.r1.th_drop etc.) are absent. The claim's numbers and robustness conclusion have no support.
